title: MUIF Common Definitions
description: Shared definitions for the Meta-Universe Interchange Format (MUIF) v1.0.

csn.description: Canonical Semantic Name: dot-separated lowerCamelCase segments, e.g. employee.compensation.salaryAgreement.

identifier.description: A stable identifier. RECOMMENDED forms: a URI, a URN, a UUID, or a scheme:value pair (e.g. employee:12345). Opaque and compared as-is.

canonicalIdentity.description: A Canonical Identity: who an object is from the perspective of its owner.

scheme.description: Identifier scheme, e.g. 'uuid', 'uri', 'urn', or an owner-defined scheme.

value.description: The identifier value within the scheme.

semverRange.description: A compatible version range, e.g. '>=2.0.0 <3.0.0' or '^2.3.1'.

fingerprint.description: Semantic Fingerprint: sha256 over the MUIF canonical form (see MMAS-Interchange).

provenance.description: Provenance of a semantic fact (see Traceability). 'owner' is semantic; 'assertedAt' is non-semantic and excluded from the fingerprint.

owner.description: The identity that owns / asserts the fact.

authority.description: The authority under which the fact is asserted.

assertedAt.description: When the fact was asserted. NON-SEMANTIC: excluded from the Semantic Fingerprint.
